answer_1.quote: In this paper, we represent a method for conditional headline generation by using a generative autoregressive Transformer based language model that is fine-tuned for the headline generation task in Finnish.

answer_2.quote: The objective function we used was the BLEU score of the generated set of headlines with regards to the true headline for 100 articles.

answer_4.quote: Three editors, one from Helsingin Sanomat and two from Ilta-Sanomat volunteered to perform this evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored headlines on three criteria: language (correct Finnish and making sense), usable (matches article without errors), and good (publishable without editing).
